english.title: Aid abet undischarged bankrupt to take part in / be concerned in the promotion / formation / management of a company
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured, **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

being an undischarged bankrupt, to take part in or be concerned in the promotion, formation or management of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY THE COMPANY..), without the leave of the court
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 11(1) and 13 of the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
